program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    right = max(c for r, c in points)
    inner_h, inner_w = bottom - top - 1, right - left - 1
    marker = next((r, c) for r, c in points if top < r < bottom and left < c < right)
    mr, mc = marker
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            out[r][c] = 4
    radius = 2
    while radius <= max(inner_h, inner_w):
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                if max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc)) == radius:
                    out[r][c] = 2
        radius += 2
    out[mr][mc] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
print(source)
